chapter.heading: Philippians 2
Christ’s Example of Humility
chapter.v: affection and sympathy,
of the same mind, having the same love, being in full accord and of one mind.
humility count others more significant than yourselves.
look not only to his own interests, but also to the interests of others.
Have this mind among yourselves, which is yours in Christ Jesus,
a thing to be grasped,
being born in the likeness of men.
even death on a cross.
the name that is above every name,
in heaven and on earth and under the earth,
Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
obeyed, so now, not only as in my presence but much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling,
his good pleasure.
disputing,
as lights in the world,
I did not run in vain or labor in vain.
the sacrificial offering of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.
Likewise you also should be glad and rejoice with me.
to send Timothy to you soon, so that I too may be cheered by news of you.
like him, who will be genuinely concerned for your welfare.
seek their own interests, not those of Jesus Christ.
he has served with me in the gospel.
I hope therefore to send him just as soon as I see how it will go with me,
I trust in the Lord that shortly I myself will come also.
minister to my need,
for he has been longing for you all and has been distressed because you heard that he was ill.
Indeed he was ill, near to death. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
I am the more eager to send him, therefore, that you may rejoice at seeing him again, and that I may be less anxious.
honor such men,
to complete what was lacking in your service to me.
